faqs.q: How much does an ID card cost at IDGen?
faqs.a: Reference pricing starts at ₹15 per PVC ID card for single-side printing and ₹16 per card for double-side printing, subject to the applicable specifications and order conditions.

faqs.q: How much does a custom printed lanyard cost?
faqs.a: The reference price for a 20 mm custom printed lanyard is ₹15 per piece.

faqs.q: How much does an event card cost?
faqs.a: The reference price for an event card is ₹35 per card. The complete event identification setup may cost more depending on lanyards, hooks and sealing requirements.

faqs.q: How much does an RFID ID card cost?
faqs.a: The reference price for an RFID ID card is ₹45 per card, subject to RFID type, specifications and compatibility requirements.

faqs.q: Do ID card prices include lanyards?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Card printing and accessories such as lanyards, holders and hooks should be considered according to the selected configuration.

faqs.q: Do bulk orders have different pricing?
faqs.a: Bulk project pricing can vary according to quantity, specifications, personalization, accessories and production requirements. Request a quotation for the exact project.

faqs.q: Is the listed price the final price?
faqs.a: The prices shown are reference prices. The final quotation depends on the confirmed product specifications, quantity, customization, accessories and applicable delivery conditions.

faqs.q: Can I order only ID cards?
faqs.a: Yes. Customers can order ID cards without accessories where required.

faqs.q: Can I order a complete ID card set?
faqs.a: Yes. Depending on the requirement, a complete setup can include the ID card, holder, hook, lanyard and applicable ultrasonic sealing.

faqs.q: Does delivery come under the listed price?
faqs.a: Delivery conditions depend on the order and destination. Confirm applicable delivery charges and terms when requesting the quotation.
